# WorkOS

> > WorkOS provides enterprise-ready authentication, authorization, and user management APIs for B2B SaaS applications.

WorkOS offers developer tools including AuthKit for authentication, SSO integrations, SCIM provisioning, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA), and enterprise security features. The platform helps SaaS companies add enterprise features like Single Sign-On, directory sync, and advanced access control without building from scratch.

## Key Topics

- WorkOS AuthKit
- Single Sign-On (SSO)
- SCIM provisioning
- Enterprise authentication
- B2B SaaS development
- Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA)
- Next.js B2B Starter Kit
- Identity management
- Multi-factor authentication (MFA)
- AI agent authentication
- BYOK (Bring Your Own Key)
- ReBAC vs RBAC
- Developer tools
- Enterprise security
